title: About Me

code.label: Motto
code.value: "Solve Complex Technical Problems with Creative Solutions"

textHtml: I'm known for strong attention to detail, high-quality work, and a perpetual drive to keep learning. I enjoy investigating technical problems and finding creative solutions. As a Java software developer specializing in web services and backend systems, I've built and maintained high-traffic services handling hundreds of millions of requests per day, ensuring data is processed securely, efficiently, and accurately.  I've voluntarily led project planning and execution. I work independently, communicate proactively, and support my colleagues, offering help when needed.
